data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'phoros', meaning 'carrier' or 'bearer'. The name Farrow carries the meaning “Far-er, traveler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
